description:
How many mapped contaminated or regulated sites sit inside a suburb, how many are within 1 km of its centre, and how far the nearest one is, for NSW, Victoria, Queensland, South Australia and Western Australia.

Coverage: NSW, Vic, Qld, SA and WA suburbs only (14,124 suburbs); no rows for Tas, ACT, NT or other territories. Current to 2026-10-01. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/contaminated-land`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: sites_mapped, sites_within_1km_of_centre, sites_per_km2, nearest_site_m. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: suburbs_environment_contaminated_land
title: Suburb · Contaminated and regulated sites
